name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches the no-timing 'you must also take the key'. Existence(target_picked_up) matches the commanded box pickup. Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) and Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) follow the 'Then' chain after the conditional. The compiler's redundancy note concerns only the stated RespondedExistence, which is kept because the task states it.

texts: If the ball is moved (blocker_moved), the key must also be taken (has_door_key happens too, at some point).
The agent must pick up the target box in the other room (target_picked_up must happen).
The box pickup must come after the key is taken (has_door_key comes before target_picked_up).
If the ball is moved (blocker_moved), the box pickup must follow it (target_picked_up happens at or after blocker_moved).
